rationale: C07 is a direct and material drafting source. The child expressly invokes the September 6, 1950 proclamation and builds on its petroleum tariff treatment. It also reproduces C07's lengthy section-350/GATT recital and adapts C07's petroleum-specific legal machinery: the Venezuelan agreement, item 3422, the covered petroleum products, the calendar-year quota, and the 1951 effective date. The child then adds the country-allocation mechanism required by the Venezuelan agreement and GATT. C22 and C04 are weaker analogues involving tariff quotas and prorated quantities, but neither contains the child's petroleum-specific foundation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: by virtue of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of September 6, 1950 (15 F.R. 6063), the United States customs treatment to be applied on and after January 1, 1951, to imports of crude petroleum, topped crude petroleum, and fuel oil derived from petroleum including fuel oil known as gas oil
shared_material.parent_excerpt: crude petroleum, topped crude petroleum, and fuel oil derived from petroleum, including fuel oil known as gas oil, entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption in any calendar year beginning with the calendar year 1951
shared_material.explanation: The child explicitly incorporates C07's petroleum tariff regime as the foundation for allocating the resulting tariff quota.

shared_material.child_excerpt: on October 30, 1947, I entered into a trade agreement with the Governments of the Commonwealth of Australia, the Kingdom of Belgium ... and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, which trade agreement consists of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the related Protocol of Provisional Application thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: on October 30, 1947, I entered into a trade agreement with the Governments of the Commonwealth of Australia, the Kingdom of Belgium ... and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, which trade agreement consists of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade and the related Protocol of Provisional Application thereof
shared_material.explanation: The child substantially reproduces C07's lengthy, distinctive recital identifying the GATT agreement and participating governments.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the President ... entered into a definitive trade agreement on November 6, 1939, with the President of the Republic of Venezuela ... [and] item 3422 of Schedule II
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the President ... entered into a definitive trade agreement on November 6, 1939, with the President of the Republic of Venezuela ... [followed by] the item listed under Internal Revenue Code Section 3422 of Schedule II
shared_material.explanation: Both directives use the same Venezuela agreement and tariff-item framework; C07 establishes the tariff quota that the child subsequently divides among supplying countries.
